claims.claim: Planning records select CAA-04 as the sole prospective NEXT, record the supplied accepted CAA-03 lineage, and preserve earlier CAA selections and conditional CAA-05.

The bounded, read-only evaluation API consumes exact four-flow CAA-03 context and sealed CAA-01 cuts; preregistered cohorts bind source, subject, packet, candidate and as-of identity while labels remain outside advisor input.
Independent Human labels drive grading of material source support, causal transfer, counterexamples, abstention, safety and harmful confidence; CAA self-scores have no grading authority.

Shadow evaluation is disabled by default and requires caller opt-in, an authenticated Human plan and a trusted call reservation gate; it enforces 50-subject, seven-day and one-call-per-subject ceilings without workflow actions.

Reports separate development from decisive cohorts and baseline from advisor results, mark measured, estimated and unknown fields, and produce a Human rollout packet with thresholds, uncertainties, alternatives and no action authority.

Four-flow and adversarial fixtures cover label and source swaps, future data, injection, false citation and analogy, grader provenance, budget and timeout boundaries, provider absence, opt-out and unauthenticated rollout.
The commit changes exactly the five authorized paths and leaves existing CAA-01/02/03, direct authoring, audit and lifecycle implementation files untouched.
